fields.Name: T308 - Communication Monitor Analytics Render
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke analytics surface: count_only-aggregated KPIs, an hourly-bucketed app-time-series-chart, and client-computed provider-health/channel-breakdown — a composition with no grid/form equivalent.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Monitor section. Success = the monitor analytics render: a KPI strip with four cards (Total Sent, Delivery Rate %, Pending, Failed), a 'Delivery Volume' time-series chart, a 'Provider Health' list, and a 'Channel Breakdown' — each populated OR showing a valid empty state. Wait for the section to finish loading. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The KPI strip renders the four metric cards with values (zeros are acceptable)
The Delivery Volume chart, Provider Health, and Channel Breakdown sections all render (populated or valid empty states)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
